head: Sorae draw music app turns a doodle into a melody on iPhone
dek: Sorae: Draw Music is a new free iPhone and iPad app where every line you draw plays back as a tune: high lines play high notes, low lines low ones, and every note stays in key. A lo-fi backing band can play along in Chill, Dreamy or Groove style.
details: Each paper in its sketchbook has its own key, scale and tempo, and you pick the colour, brush and instrument separately, from piano and kalimba to harp and flute. Sketches export as a video with sound, a picture or an audio file. There's no sign-up and no ads; Sorae Pro, monthly or a one-time purchase, unlocks every instrument, brush and paper, longer pieces, MIDI export and exports without the 'Made with Sorae' mark. It came out on 13 November.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), free, Pro by subscription or one-time purchase
means: If you like music but can't read notes, you can make a short tune by drawing, alone or with your kids.
todo: Try the free version first; the listing doesn't give the Pro prices, so check them in the app before buying.
thumb_words: DRAW A LINE, HEAR A SONG
